basis: Platelet dysfunction and oculocutaneous albinism define disease; immune dysfunction supported by leukopenia and recurrent infections in 1/1 reported patient.
Disease located in veins; no additional organ applies across this umbrella.
Craniofacial skeletal malformation syndrome; intellectual disability/developmental delay in 7/19 (~37%). Hypertelorism does not itself indicate eye damage.
Inherited retinal/macular dystrophy umbrella.
Primary distal skeletal myopathy with weakness and contractures; cardiomyopathy is very rare; dyspnea alone does not establish pulmonary damage.
Lens abnormalities, glaucoma, short stature and joint stiffness define disease. Isolated cardiac reports do not establish involvement in >=30%.
Immune-mediated skeletal myositis; dermatomyositis accounts for roughly 80-90% of juvenile cases, with characteristic inflammatory skin disease.
Focal cerebral seizures; sensory manifestations do not imply damage to eyes, ears or other sensory organs.
Localized testicular reproductive neoplasm; no hormone excess, endocrine failure or other covered organ involvement is defined.
Inherited metabolic calcification disorder with calcinosis cutis in 8/8 patients. Gingivitis and conjunctivitis lack established frequencies or lasting damage.
Congenital muscular dystrophy; cerebral white-matter abnormality reported in 1/1 assessed patient supports CNS involvement despite preserved cognition.
Developmental malformation of cerebral cortex.
Lissencephaly, cerebellar hypoplasia and cleft palate define the syndrome; palate belongs to the oral gastrointestinal axis.
Vaginal disease is outside the covered organ axes; infection is only one subtype of this umbrella.
Central/peripheral neural and cutaneous neurofibromas define disease; bilateral vestibular schwannomas are a major feature. Lisch nodules do not damage vision.
Autoinflammatory disease with recurrent peritonitis ~94%, pleuritis ~47% and arthritis ~39%; these are inflammatory lesions, not pain alone. Renal amyloidosis is rare.
Myeloid leukemia arising in hematopoietic cells and marrow; FLT3-ITD does not establish common additional organ damage.
Malignant neoplasm originating in the auditory system; other organs are not consistently involved across subtypes.
Disorder of urinary continence during sleep; bladder function falls within the renal axis despite psychiatric ancestry.
Filarial nematode infection umbrella; skin, eye and pulmonary damage vary by subtype and are not established in most patients across the group.
Neurologic movement disorder; tremor, spasms and myalgia do not establish primary skeletal muscle damage.
Skeletal dysplasia; gingival overgrowth 13/15, bifid tongue 7/11 and dental defects support oral involvement; hearing impairment 6/12. CNS findings are isolated reports.
Renal salt-wasting tubulopathy with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and characteristic sensorineural deafness defines Bartter type 4A.
Marrow failure and mucocutaneous disease define dyskeratosis congenita; cerebellar hypoplasia, microcephaly and developmental delay occur in 4/4 reported patients.
Chronic Klebsiella granulomatous infection of respiratory mucosa, especially nose and nasopharynx; occasional lip or skin extension does not meet the threshold.
